purpose: gnssmap1 (kernel q10jr5 / 0355, ioctl 121): ONE mapping action per boot after the Wi-Fi read-only guard and a 2 s console pause: inventory only: guard + VAs of the existing io_submap mappings, no new mapping, no access. Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
